Product + FAQ + Breadcrumb schema on every product page
Real on-brand imagery embedded site-wide as optimized WebP
Templated product-page body copy is the main ceiling on ranking
Domain not yet pointed to harmonyadditive.in / not in Search Console
quick_wins: Point harmonyadditive.in at the Vercel deploy + verify in GSC, submit sitemap
Claim Google Business Profile + IndiaMART/TradeIndia listings

findings.title: No CrUX field data yet
findings.description: Fresh deployment; Core Web Vitals field data needs ~28 days of Chrome traffic.
findings.recommendation: Run PageSpeed Insights on the live domain; revisit CrUX after launch.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: 15 full blog articles with author + Person schema
industry pages problem-led + FAQ + real product lists

findings.title: Templated product-page body copy
findings.description: 173 product pages are unique by title/description/schema/industry set, but body copy is templated; same-type SKUs read similarly.
findings.recommendation: Add real TDS data per product (active %, appearance, ionic nature, pH, dosage, packaging) to make each page deep and rich-result-eligible. Do not fabricate specs.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Organization, LocalBusiness, WebSite, Breadcrumb, FAQ, Blog/Person, ItemList, AboutPage
Product schema x173 with sku/mpn, brand, manufacturer, APEO-free, system, origin

findings.title: Product offers omitted
findings.description: Product schema omits offers/price to avoid invalid data for a price-on-request B2B catalog.
findings.recommendation: Add Offer with availability + 'price on request' policy once decided.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: All imagery optimized to WebP (logo 1.6MB->7kB, frames 12MB->2MB, site images 16MB->2.3MB)

findings.title: 87-frame scroll hero
findings.description: Homepage hero preloads 87 frame images; main request-count/LCP cost, inherent to the animation.
findings.recommendation: Measure LCP on live domain; if weak, cut frame count or serve a lighter mobile hero.
